summary: All reported point-in-time numbers match primary artifacts and no fake ground truth or prediction-normalized score was found. Full training and paper evaluation remain incomplete, while checkpoint publication/resume and backup state validation have material unexercised gaps.
audit_freeze_note: This initial verdict excludes working-tree revisions after the audited commit; those require a separate follow-up review.

gt_provenance.details: Training targets come from released dataset motion. Static reference, recomputation parity, and simulator-feedback checks are explicitly labelled proxies/diagnostics; no prediction-derived value is presented as dataset ground truth.

score_normalization.details: Losses divide by valid target entries, not prediction statistics. Near-zero values are deterministic parity/wiring checks and are not presented as performance.

result_existence.details: All reported numeric values match preserved artifacts, but no full-run checkpoint or milestone evaluation exists, the compute ledger is stale, several operational/environment claims are only partially evidenced, and remote release state was not queried.

dead_code.details: Current claimed metrics are called and recorded through primary code paths. The future milestone evaluator has no output because no eligible checkpoint exists and no result from it is claimed.

scope.details: The full schedule is incomplete; closed-loop evidence is one prompt/seed on an old 101-update pilot; normalization/runtime differ from an unpublished premerged/eight-rank setup; official benchmarks and real-robot/human evaluation are absent.

findings: Checkpoint model/optimizer files are written to final names before an atomic ready manifest; resume selects the highest model filename without manifest/hash validation and can proceed without optimizer state.
Existing local evaluation receipt, feedback, and archive files are trusted on retries when no expected hash is supplied.
Deletion-critical guards use assert and disappear under optimized Python, although the observed worker did not use -O.
Completion does not require the exact fresh rank set; process matching is generic and there is no stale/hang detector.
FAILED/process-absent paths stop without automatic verified resume, and some abrupt failures are not published as failure assets.
Release asset discovery is not paginated.
No real full-training checkpoint has exercised publication, cleanup, or resume.

claims.claim: Official public files were acquired and the three-component full schedule was launched.
The full 1M schedule or paper performance has been reproduced.
Both ranks had completed 270 updates at the frozen snapshot.
Four-update DDP execution and one-batch recomputation parity passed.
Static A-pose tracking remained upright for eight simulated seconds.
The old 101-update model executed a real-feedback MuJoCo loop.
Recorded simulator state was fed back consistently into planner prefixes.
Future checkpoint backup, cleanup, and recovery are fully robust.
Preserved GitHub release assets remain available now.
